criterion: 不可暫停來源有明確耗盡與缺口／停止處置；即時控制的聚合選擇符合期限；硬體必要 bank 有理由、容量、複製與所有權設計，並驗證使用中緩衝不被覆寫。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: An unpausable source declares overflow behavior; an immediate control path avoids batching that misses its deadline; DMA banks retain ownership until completion. Required finding for the counterexample: Treating hardware banks as proof of backpressure or overwriting an active DMA buffer violates FLOW-SOURCE-001.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
